images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE landscape 3:2 teaching illustration for Thai lower secondary pupils. Polished accurate textbook realism, clean light background, generous spacing, natural colors and teal accents. No text, captions, logos, watermarks or invented numerical data. Concrete clear educational scenes, no decorative science symbols. Nature of scientific knowledge: same team of school scientists studies three pots of seedlings, measures heights and records observations; nearby an initial hand-drawn explanation sketch is thoughtfully revised on a fresh page after new observations of additional seedlings. Convey evidence, reasoned interpretation and willingness to revise conclusions, no arbitrary certainty badges. Unified classroom scene with evidence and revision clearly visible.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE landscape 3:2 teaching illustration for Thai lower secondary pupils. Polished accurate textbook realism, clean light background, generous spacing, natural colors and teal accents. No text, captions, logos, watermarks or invented numerical data. Concrete clear educational scenes, no decorative science symbols. Four equal independent panels, no progression arrows or hierarchy: scientific fact, law, theory and model using gas as coherent example. Panel one observed inflated balloon with measuring tape; panel two sealed gas syringe compressing air with a pressure gauge, showing pressure-volume relationship qualitatively without invented numbers; panel three magnified gas particles in random motion colliding with container walls explaining pressure; panel four physical ball model representing gas particles in a transparent box. Theory explains, law describes a relationship; never imply theory becomes law. Keep apparatus plausible, no chemical hazards.
